en.headline: Post Malone postpones September Hong Kong concert at Kai Tak Stadium
en.dek: Live Nation Hong Kong said the 16 September show has been postponed with full refunds for tickets bought through official platforms; no new date was given.
body: American singer and rapper Post Malone has postponed his Hong Kong concert scheduled for 16 September at Kai Tak Stadium, concert organiser Live Nation Hong Kong announced on Thursday.
The statement gave no reason for the postponement and said fans who bought tickets through official platforms would receive full refunds. Original ticket prices ranged from HK$699 to HK$3,199.
The move forms part of a wider postponement of Post Malone’s Asian and Australian stadium dates. No rescheduled Hong Kong date has been announced.

zh.headline: Post Malone啟德體育館演唱會延期 主辦方安排全額退款
zh.dek: Live Nation Hong Kong周四宣布原定9月16日啟德體育館演唱會延期，經官方渠道購票的觀眾可獲全額退款，暫未公布新日期。
body: 美國歌手兼說唱歌手Post Malone原定9月16日於啟德體育館舉行的演唱會已延期，主辦方Live Nation Hong Kong於周四公布有關安排。
聲明未有交代延期原因，並表示經官方平台購票的觀眾將獲全額退款。門票原價由699港元至3,199港元不等。
是次延期屬Post Malone亞洲及澳洲體育館巡演多個場次整體延期的一部分。香港場次目前未有公布改期日期。
